children.title: Application State Store and Record Architecture for Process Continuity

detail.title: Application State Store and Record Architecture for Process Continuity
detail.summary: An examination of how record storage interfaces and owned kernel records support state persistence across stateless invocations.
detail.reason: Synthesizes architectural source findings on record storage to examine continuity guarantees.

detail.title: WAKE Continuity and Accountability
detail.question: How do durable state and mechanically enforced rules ensure process continuity across model invocations?
detail.reason: This project investigates the core mechanism of the WAKE agent—the interplay between disposable model invocations and the governing durable record—to determine if it constitutes a genuinely persistent process or a sequence of snapshots.
